android.desc:
WhatsApp Scheduler: Auto Sender is an automated message scheduling and reminder tool to compose, schedule, and broadcast WhatsApp messages at exact future timestamps.

Key Features:
- ⏰ Exact Future Scheduling: Schedule messages for specific dates, times, and recurring intervals.
- 🔁 Custom Repeat Frequencies: Schedule messages to repeat Every Minute, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly.
- 👥 Multi-Contact & Group Messaging: Send reminders to multiple individual contacts or organized groups.
- 📝 Pre-Saved Message Templates: Quick-insert customizable templates for birthdays, meetings, follow-ups, and notifications.
- 🔒 100% Local & Private: All message data, recipient phone numbers, and schedules remain encrypted locally on your device with JSON backup & restore.
- 🌐 Meta Cloud API Gateway: Optional support for Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud REST API for automated backend sending.

---------------------------------------------------
ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE API DISCLOSURE & USAGE NOTICE
---------------------------------------------------
This application uses the Android AccessibilityService API to provide its core automated message scheduling functionality:
1. What it does: When a scheduled message timer expires, the Accessibility Service is utilized solely to automate the sending of your pre-composed message within WhatsApp (finding and clicking the send button on your behalf) so that messages can be dispatched hands-free without manual intervention.
2. User Consent: Accessibility service is strictly optional and requires your explicit authorization during initial setup. You can enable or disable this service at any time in Android Settings.
3. Privacy & Data Collection: The AccessibilityService API is used EXCLUSIVELY for interacting with the send action. It DOES NOT monitor your screen, DOES NOT read your personal chat history, DOES NOT log keystrokes, and DOES NOT collect, store, or share any personal user data.
